blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Prosecutors have ordered the release of 236 members of the Lakbayani protest caravan who were detained for more than 70 hours following their arrest during a protest in Muntinlupa City, the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) College of Development Communication (CDC) said on Wednesday (Nov. 18). The prosecutor at the Muntinlupa Hall of Justice had decided to release the detainees for further investigation, the college announced. The release does not mean the charges against them have been dropped, as they are expected to further legal proceedings in the coming weeks. READ: Over 200 […]...
